knowledge:
- key_parameters: min_count=Minimum read count threshold (typically 5) below which loci are filtered to prevent adverse effects on downstream variance calculations ;; max_count=Maximum read count threshold (typically 500) above which loci are filtered to remove potential PCR duplicates ;; group_column=The column name in the phenotype data (pData) that defines the sample groups ;; comparison_groups=A named vector specifying which groups represent 'case' and 'control' in the differential test ;; disp_groups=A named logical vector indicating whether to estimate dispersion for the case and control groups ;; methylation_group_column=The column name in phenotype data used to recover group methylation rates in DSS tests ;; methylation_groups=A named vector specifying the case and control groups for recovering group methylation rates in DSS tests
- alternatives: bsseq::read.bismark=Preferred over the deprecated methylSigReadData() for reading Bismark coverage files, genome-wide CpG reports, or MethylDackel bedGraphs ;; diff_binomial=A binomial test based on the methylKit package, used for benchmarking but not recommended for general use as it ignores biological variability ;; diff_dss_fit and diff_dss_test=Wrappers for the DSS package, preferred when fitting general models with paired designs or continuous covariates
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing WGBS or RRBS data to detect differentially methylated cytosines (DMCs) or regions (DMRs) across experimental groups, with or without covariates.
- pitfalls: Low coverage loci (< 5 reads) can distort variance calculations and must be filtered ;; High coverage loci (> 500 reads) likely represent PCR duplicates and should be removed ;; C-to-T and G-to-A SNPs confound bisulfite conversion and must be filtered out using a GRanges object of known SNP locations ;; Skipping filter_loci_by_group_coverage() for group comparisons can allow a single sample to dominate the test ;; Conversely, filter_loci_by_group_coverage() must be skipped when testing continuous covariates because no discrete groups exist

workflows.name: methylsig_standard_workflow
workflows.intent: Identify differentially methylated cytosines or regions between two groups using the standard beta-binomial or binomial test.
workflows.stages: 1. Read Bismark/MethylDackel files using bsseq::read.bismark() ;; 2. Filter low and high coverage loci using filter_loci_by_coverage() ;; 3. Filter out confounding SNP locations using filter_loci_by_location() ;; 4. Aggregate CpG data into windows or regions using tile_by_windows() or tile_by_regions() ;; 5. Filter loci by group coverage using filter_loci_by_group_coverage() ;; 6. Test for differential methylation using diff_methylsig() or diff_binomial()
workflows.code:
files = c(
    system.file('extdata', 'bis_cov1.cov', package='methylSig'),
    system.file('extdata', 'bis_cov2.cov', package='methylSig')
)

bsseq_stranded = bsseq::read.bismark(
    files = files,
    colData = data.frame(row.names = c('test1','test2')),
    rmZeroCov = FALSE,
    strandCollapse = FALSE
)

data(BS.cancer.ex, package = 'bsseqData')
bs = BS.cancer.ex[1:10000]

bs = filter_loci_by_coverage(bs, min_count = 5, max_count = 500)

remove_gr = GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = c('chr21', 'chr21', 'chr21'),
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(
        start = c(9411552, 9411784, 9412099),
        end = c(9411552, 9411784, 9412099)
    )
)

bs = filter_loci_by_location(bs = bs, gr = remove_gr)

windowed_bs = tile_by_windows(bs = bs, win_size = 10000)

data(promoters_gr, package = 'methylSig')

promoters_bs = tile_by_regions(bs = bs, gr = promoters_gr)

bs = filter_loci_by_group_coverage(
    bs = bs,
    group_column = 'Type',
    c('cancer' = 2, 'normal' = 2))

diff_gr = diff_methylsig(
    bs = bs,
    group_column = 'Type',
    comparison_groups = c('case' = 'cancer', 'control' = 'normal'),
    disp_groups = c('case' = TRUE, 'control' = TRUE),
    local_window_size = 0,
    t_approx = TRUE,
    n_cores = 1)

diff_gr = diff_binomial(
    bs = bs,
    group_column = 'Type',
    comparison_groups = c('case' = 'cancer', 'control' = 'normal'))

workflows.name: dss_general_model_workflow
workflows.intent: Fit and test general models (such as paired designs or continuous covariates) for differential methylation using DSS wrappers.
workflows.stages: 1. Read and preprocess data (filtering by coverage and location) ;; 2. Filter loci by group coverage using filter_loci_by_group_coverage() (skip if testing a continuous covariate) ;; 3. Fit the model using diff_dss_fit() ;; 4. Define the contrast matrix ;; 5. Test the contrast and recover group methylation rates using diff_dss_test()
workflows.code:
data(BS.cancer.ex, package = 'bsseqData')
bs = BS.cancer.ex[1:10000]

bs = filter_loci_by_coverage(bs, min_count = 5, max_count = 500)

bs = filter_loci_by_group_coverage(
    bs = bs,
    group_column = 'Type',
    c('cancer' = 2, 'normal' = 2))

diff_fit_simple = diff_dss_fit(
    bs = bs,
    design = bsseq::pData(bs),
    formula = as.formula('~ Type'))

simple_contrast = matrix(c(0,1), ncol = 1)

diff_simple_gr = diff_dss_test(
    bs = bs,
    diff_fit = diff_fit_simple,
    contrast = simple_contrast,
    methylation_group_column = 'Type',
    methylation_groups = c('case' = 'cancer', 'control' = 'normal'))

diff_fit_paired = diff_dss_fit(
    bs = bs,
    design = bsseq::pData(bs),
    formula = '~ Type + Pair')

paired_contrast = matrix(c(0,1,0,0), ncol = 1)

diff_paired_gr = diff_dss_test(
    bs = bs,
    diff_fit = diff_fit_paired,
    contrast = paired_contrast,
    methylation_group_column = 'Type',
    methylation_groups = c('case' = 'cancer', 'control' = 'normal'))

bsseq::pData(bs)$num_covariate = c(84, 96, 93, 10, 18, 9)

diff_fit_num = diff_dss_fit(
    bs = bs,
    design = bsseq::pData(bs),
    formula = '~ num_covariate')

num_contrast = matrix(c(0,1), ncol = 1)

diff_num_gr = diff_dss_test(
    bs = bs,
    diff_fit = diff_fit_num,
    contrast = num_contrast,
    methylation_group_column = 'num_covariate')
